name: Mukbang Idol
source:
You ever feel bored and wanna watch someone else eat? Nah, me neither.

Either way, you really wanna help this streamer grow bigger. What a damn saint you are!!!

[From [url=https://liminace.itch.io/mukbang-idol]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你有沒有閒得發慌，想看別人吃東西的時候？沒有？嗐，我也沒有。

總之，你特別想幫這位實況主的人氣越來越高。你他媽可真是個大善人！！！

［摘自[url=https://liminace.itch.io/mukbang-idol]itch.io[/url]］
